title: Purported AI-Generated Impersonations of Albanian Cardiologist Spiro Qirko and Journalist Ilir Topi Were Reportedly Used on Facebook to Promote Hypertension Product in Kosovo

behaviors.text: An allegedly AI-generated video circulating on Facebook appeared to impersonate Albanian cardiologist a person and journalist a person in order to market "Hyper Caps" as a treatment for hypertension in Kosovo.
An AI-detection tool reportedly assessed the media as likely AI-generated, and the product was reportedly not listed as holding marketing authorization in Kosovo.
